answer.content:
Unfortunately, no — the order details I can see don't include any estimated ship or delivery dates either. For each order I only have the order ID, items with their options and prices, the shipping address, the order status (pending/delivered/etc.), and the payment history (amounts and payment method). There are no timestamps or dates of any kind in that information.

I'm sorry I can't determine which order was placed most recently. If you remember anything else about the order — the items, the amount, or where it shipped — I'd be glad to help identify it. Is there anything else I can help you with?
